definitions.explanation: A vertical structure that encloses or divides an area.

examples.english: To hang a picture on the wall.

examples.japanese: {壁|かべ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{白|しろ}く→白い：00587_shiroi⟧⟦{塗|ぬ}った→塗る：01174_nuru⟧。

examples.english: The wall between our room and the next is thin, so I can hear voices.

examples.japanese: {壁|かべ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦ぶつかって→ぶつかる：02412_butsukaru⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧、⟦あきらめない→諦める：01813_akirameru⟧。
examples.english: Even when I hit a wall, I won't give up.

examples.japanese: ⟦{年齢|ねんれい}→年齢：01490_nenrei⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{壁|かべ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{乗|の}り{越|こ}えて→乗り越える：04620_norikoeru⟧、⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧⟦こと→こと：01164_koto⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{挑戦|ちょうせん}したい→挑戦：03495_chousen⟧。
examples.english: I want to overcome the age barrier and take on new challenges.

notes:
{壁|かべ} means 'wall' both literally and figuratively.

Common collocations:
- {壁|かべ}に{掛|か}ける: to hang on a wall
- {壁|かべ}を{塗|ぬ}る: to paint a wall
- {壁|かべ}にぶつかる: to hit a wall (literal/figurative)

Figurative:
- {言葉|ことば}の{壁|かべ}: language barrier
- {心|こころ}の{壁|かべ}: emotional barrier
- {壁|かべ}を{乗|の}り{越|こ}える: to overcome a barrier
